label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like _____' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verse: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
note: Hinds are female deer — sure-footed on cliffs where nothing else can stand.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not _____.
verse: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
note: The One who keeps you never dozes off — you can sleep because He won't.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and _____, and peacocks.
verse: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
note: Solomon's ships brought home gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks — every three years, like clockwork.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; _____ our days as of old.
verse: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
note: Lamentations' closing prayer: turn us back to you, and make our days new as of old.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I have _____ out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verse: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
note: 'I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions' — sins gone like a cloud burned away by the sun.
